# Consent lifecycle

As of 2026-07-20, consent lifecycle names the governed state model from grant through expiry, revocation, and recovery.

**Owner.** Product Ops

- Consent state includes granted, expired, revoked, and recovered. [source: sources/consent-analysis.md#states]
- Recovery should be measured separately from first-time consent. [source: raw/consent-export.csv#L2]
